# isFunction

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is a function.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isFunction() — Checks whether a value is a function. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/base</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isFunction(value: unknown): value is Function;
```

Classified by its internal tag, so ordinary, `async`, generator and async-generator functions all pass. A class is a function too.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is a function; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `Function` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isFunction(function () {}); // => true
isFunction(async function () {}); // => true
isFunction(Math.max); // => true
isFunction(null); // => false
isFunction("fn"); // => false
isFunction({}); // => false
```
